plan.notes: Source: HSU College of Performing Arts and Social Sciences, Psychology (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2026/04/03, via the official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 16+15+16+16+15+15+15+12 = 120. The plan prints Sophomore Spring TOTAL as 15, but its five listed courses (Mental Health Elective 3, PSYC Elective 3, Natural Science 4, Directed Elective in Writing or Behavioral Science 3, Minor Course 3) sum to 16; the printed plan grand total of 120 is consistent only with the actual sum of 16, so the printed '15' is a catalog typo - kept verbatim, documented here, total_credits uses the sequenced sum. In addition to core courses, all psychology majors complete the ETS Major Field Test in Psychology. The source prints old (pre-2026) course numbers alongside the new ones; new course numbers are used as codes. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
